items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Then's when I got together with Dick Hyman... Dick made the arrangement, and in the mean time I asked all the guys in the band... did they want to make it?

ctx.x: So anyway, a couple of nights he came by. And he said, Cozy, I'm back again. I says okay, how are you, you know. I said I've got a number for you, and just off the top of my head, not thinking, I said 'Topsy.' Now I knew that 'Topsy' was Art Tatum's theme song way back, Basie did it but with the saxophones, they were fast, more rapid, you

know. (HUMMING) He says, okay. So I was talking to him and he talked very intelligent that night, this night, you know. I said well, I said, it's going to cost you XX amount of dollars for the arrangements. I said I've got to have the green light on the studio where we work. The engineers. And just every- things, so he says, okay, Cozy. I said we'll have to have our money deposited in the Union before we ever budge. Because I didn't know him, you know. So anyway Max Aaron was secretary then, he's the president of…
guys in the band, in Arthur's band, did they want to make it? I never used my band, I used that band, Arthur Godfrey band, because all of them were expert readers.
